clock_alignment.mapping: Piecewise linear between actual same-run GPIO/DWT anchors, local extrapolation outside; inferred timestamp allowance100us.

startup.scope: Warm runtime only. First STROBE uses the identical phase2 IRQ marker and same-run GPIO/DWT-fitted runtime origin; not a cold button-to-exposure measurement.
startup.config_scope: Additional pre-START repeat/next writes and repeat/next/frame-counter readbacks; time from AST.config_begin through AST.config_end, before any START.

external_strobe.scope: PD0 mirror of PA0 EXTI interrupts after explicit activation, through stable post-save sensor observation. Boot HIGH/chatter excluded. This confirms IRQ waveform/count externally, not independent direct PA0 electrical capture.

scope: Warm RAM, no cold power-on or Standby. All currents include populated board and card. Source-image equality is separate evidence. Normal STOP and automatic FSM2 are software observations, not exact sensor transitions.
